description: lib.rs:355-357,431,691,1075,1085,1099,1103,1106 — Clippy (doc_markdown) flags identifiers and numeric literals in doc comments that are not backtick-wrapped. Examples: '1_773_532_800' at line 355, 'web_pki_policy' at line 691, 'max_validity_secs' at line 691, 'SubjectAltName' at line 431, 'smime_policy' at line 1075, 'require_rfc822_san' at line 1075, 'MissingRfc822San' at line 1099, 'required_leaf_eku' at line 1106. Fix: wrap each flagged token in backticks. Mostly mechanical. Most occurrences are in test-module doc comments.
title: [rusty/pkix-profiles] doc_markdown: identifiers/numeric literals in doc comments need backticks
